title: Phrasal verbs of the week
goal: Learn ten more phrasal verbs for travel and daily life and see how to use them in different sentences.
goal_it: Imparare altri dieci phrasal verbs per viaggi e vita quotidiana e vedere come usarli in frasi diverse.

steps.title: Phrasal verbs: get on, get off
steps.title_it: Phrasal verbs: get on, get off
en: Last week you met ten phrasal verbs. This week there are ten more, many of them about travel and daily routines.
Reminder: if the object is a pronoun, it goes in the middle (pick it up, not pick up it). Verbs with a preposition after them (get on the bus, look after the kids) are not separable.
it: La settimana scorsa hai visto dieci phrasal verbs. Questa settimana ce ne sono altri dieci, molti legati ai viaggi e alla vita quotidiana.
Promemoria: se il complemento è un pronome va in mezzo (pick it up, non pick up it). I verbi con una preposizione dopo (get on the bus, look after the kids) non si separano.

head: Phrasal verb
Meaning
Italiano
rows: to climb onto public transport; also: to have a good relationship (get on with someone). Not separable.
salire su (mezzo pubblico); andare d'accordo (get on with)
to leave public transport. Opposite of get on. Not separable.

examples.en: We got on the bus at the station.
examples.it: Siamo saliti sull'autobus alla stazione.

examples.en: I get on really well with my sister.
examples.it: Vado molto d'accordo con mia sorella.

examples.en: Which stop do I get on at?
examples.it: A quale fermata salgo?

examples.en: Get off at the next stop.
examples.it: Scendi alla prossima fermata.

examples.en: She got off the train in Leeds.
examples.it: È scesa dal treno a Leeds.

examples.en: Please get off the bus at the front door.
examples.it: Per favore scendete dall'autobus dalla porta anteriore.

steps.title: Phrasal verbs: pick up, drop off
steps.title_it: Phrasal verbs: pick up, drop off
en: Learn the whole phrase and read each example aloud.
it: Impara l'espressione intera e leggi ad alta voce ogni esempio.

head: Phrasal verb
Meaning
Italiano
rows: to lift something from a surface; to collect someone or something by car; to learn something easily. Separable.
raccogliere; passare a prendere; imparare (senza sforzo)
to leave someone or something at a place, usually by car. Separable.

examples.en: Pick up your bag, please. Pick it up!
examples.it: Raccogli la borsa, per favore. Raccoglila!

examples.en: I'll pick you up at eight.
examples.it: Passo a prenderti alle otto.

examples.en: She picked up some Spanish on holiday.
examples.it: Ha imparato un po' di spagnolo in vacanza.

examples.en: Dad dropped me off at school.
examples.it: Papà mi ha lasciato a scuola.

examples.en: Can you drop the parcel off at the post office?
examples.it: Puoi lasciare il pacco all'ufficio postale?

examples.en: Drop us off outside the cinema, please.
examples.it: Lasciaci davanti al cinema, per favore.

steps.title: Phrasal verbs: set off, look up
steps.title_it: Phrasal verbs: set off, look up
en: Learn the whole phrase and read each example aloud.
it: Impara l'espressione intera e leggi ad alta voce ogni esempio.

head: Phrasal verb
Meaning
Italiano
rows: to start a journey. Not separable.
to search for information in a dictionary or online; to raise your eyes. Separable for the first meaning.
cercare (in un dizionario, online); alzare lo sguardo

examples.en: We set off at six to avoid the traffic.
examples.it: Siamo partiti alle sei per evitare il traffico.

examples.en: They set off for Edinburgh this morning.
examples.it: Sono partiti per Edimburgo stamattina.

examples.en: What time are you setting off tomorrow?
examples.it: A che ora parti domani?

examples.en: I don't know this word. I'll look it up.
examples.it: Non conosco questa parola. La cerco.

examples.en: Look up the train times online.
examples.it: Cerca gli orari dei treni online.

examples.en: He looked up and saw a plane.
examples.it: Alzò lo sguardo e vide un aereo.

steps.title: Phrasal verbs: look after, wake up
steps.title_it: Phrasal verbs: look after, wake up
en: Learn the whole phrase and read each example aloud.
it: Impara l'espressione intera e leggi ad alta voce ogni esempio.

head: Phrasal verb
Meaning
Italiano
rows: to take care of a person, animal or thing. Not separable (look after + object).
to stop sleeping; wake someone up = to make them stop sleeping. Separable when it has an object.

examples.en: Who looks after the dog when you are away?
examples.it: Chi si occupa del cane quando sei via?

examples.en: She is looking after her little brother today.
examples.it: Oggi si occupa del fratellino.

examples.en: Look after your passport.
examples.it: Abbi cura del passaporto.

examples.en: I woke up at five because of the noise.
examples.it: Mi sono svegliato alle cinque per il rumore.

examples.en: Please wake me up at seven.
examples.it: Per favore svegliami alle sette.

examples.en: Don't wake the baby up.
examples.it: Non svegliare il bambino.

steps.title: Phrasal verbs: go out, sit down
steps.title_it: Phrasal verbs: go out, sit down
en: Learn the whole phrase and read each example aloud.
it: Impara l'espressione intera e leggi ad alta voce ogni esempio.

head: Phrasal verb
Meaning
Italiano
rows: to leave your home to do something social; to have a relationship with someone. Not separable.
uscire (con amici); stare insieme a qualcuno
to move from standing to sitting. Opposite: stand up. Not separable.

examples.en: Shall we go out for dinner tonight?
examples.it: Usciamo a cena stasera?

examples.en: They have been going out for two years.
examples.it: Stanno insieme da due anni.

examples.en: I don't often go out on weekdays.
examples.it: Non esco spesso nei giorni feriali.

examples.en: Please sit down and wait here.
examples.it: Per favore siediti e aspetta qui.

examples.en: He sat down next to me on the train.
examples.it: Si è seduto accanto a me sul treno.

examples.en: Sit down, the film is about to start.
examples.it: Siediti, il film sta per iniziare.

steps.q: Which phrasal verb means 'to start a journey'?
steps.q_it: Quale phrasal verb significa 'iniziare un viaggio'?
steps.why: Set off means to begin a journey.
steps.why_it: Set off significa partire.

steps.q: The bus stops. Passengers want to leave it. They ...
steps.q_it: L'autobus si ferma. I passeggeri vogliono scendere. Loro ...
steps.why: Get off is the opposite of get on: leave public transport.
steps.why_it: Get off è il contrario di get on: scendere dal mezzo.

steps.q: 'I'll pick you up at eight.' What will the speaker do?
steps.q_it: 'I'll pick you up at eight.' Che cosa farà chi parla?
options: Collect the other person at eight
steps.why: Pick someone up means to collect them, usually by car.
steps.why_it: Pick someone up significa passare a prenderlo, di solito in auto.

steps.q: You don't know the meaning of a word. You ... in a dictionary.
steps.q_it: Non conosci il significato di una parola. La ... nel dizionario.
steps.why: Look up means to search for information.
steps.why_it: Look up significa cercare un'informazione.

steps.q: Which sentence is correct?
steps.q_it: Quale frase è corretta?
options: She looked at after the baby.
steps.why: Look after is not separable: look after + object.
steps.why_it: Look after non si separa: look after + complemento.

steps.q: 'Dad dropped me off at the station.' This means Dad ...
steps.q_it: 'Dad dropped me off at the station.' Significa che papà ...
options: took me there by car and left me
woke me up at the station
steps.why: Drop someone off means to leave them at a place, usually by car.
steps.why_it: Drop someone off significa lasciare qualcuno in un posto, di solito in auto.

steps.q: Which one is NOT a good reply to 'Shall we go out tonight?'
steps.q_it: Quale NON è una buona risposta a 'Shall we go out tonight?'
options: Yes, let's go to the cinema.
steps.why: Sit down means to take a seat, so it does not answer the question.
steps.why_it: Sit down significa sedersi, quindi non risponde alla domanda.

steps.q: 'He gets on well with his colleagues.' Here get on means ...
steps.q_it: 'He gets on well with his colleagues.' Qui get on significa ...
steps.why: Get on with someone = to have a friendly relationship.
steps.why_it: Get on with someone = andare d'accordo.

steps.q: We ___ the bus at the main station. (get on, past)
steps.q_it: Noi ___ sull'autobus alla stazione principale. (get on, passato)
steps.why: Past simple of get is got.
steps.why_it: Il past simple di get è got.

steps.q: Please ___ at the next stop. (get off)
steps.q_it: Per favore ___ alla prossima fermata. (get off)
steps.why: Leave the bus: get off.
steps.why_it: Scendere dal bus: get off.

steps.q: My dad is going to ___ at the airport. (collect me)
steps.q_it: Mio padre mi ___ all'aeroporto. (pick up)
steps.why: Pick me up: the pronoun goes in the middle.
steps.why_it: Pick me up: il pronome va in mezzo.

steps.q: We ___ at five in the morning to reach Rome by lunch. (set off, past)
steps.q_it: Noi ___ alle cinque del mattino per arrivare a Roma per pranzo. (set off, passato)
steps.why: Set is irregular: set, set, set.
steps.why_it: Set è irregolare: set, set, set.

steps.q: I don't know this word. I'll ___. (search for it)
steps.q_it: Non conosco questa parola. La cerco. (look up)
steps.why: Look it up: the pronoun goes in the middle.
steps.why_it: Look it up: il pronome va in mezzo.

steps.q: Who ___ the children when you are at work? (look after)
steps.q_it: Chi ___ i bambini quando sei al lavoro? (look after)
steps.why: Present simple question with who as subject: who looks after.
steps.why_it: Domanda al present simple con who soggetto: who looks after.

steps.q: The alarm didn't ring, so I ___ late. (wake up, past)
steps.q_it: La sveglia non ha suonato, quindi ___ tardi. (wake up, passato)
steps.why: Past simple of wake is woke.
steps.why_it: Il past simple di wake è woke.

steps.q: They ___ every Friday night. (leave home to have fun)
steps.q_it: Loro ___ ogni venerdì sera. (uscire)
steps.why: Go out = leave home for a social activity.
steps.why_it: Go out = uscire per divertirsi.

steps.q: Build the sentence.
steps.q_it: Costruisci la frase.
answers: We got off the train in Manchester
steps.why: Get off is not separable: get off + the train.
steps.why_it: Get off non si separa: get off + the train.

steps.q: Build the sentence.
steps.q_it: Costruisci la frase.
answers: Can you drop me off at the station?
steps.why: Drop me off: the pronoun goes in the middle.
steps.why_it: Drop me off: il pronome va in mezzo.

steps.q: Build the sentence.
steps.q_it: Costruisci la frase.
answers: I looked the word up in a dictionary
steps.why: Look up is separable: look the word up.
steps.why_it: Look up è separabile: look the word up.

steps.q: Build the sentence.
steps.q_it: Costruisci la frase.
answers: She always looks after her grandmother
steps.why: Always goes before the main verb; look after stays together.
steps.why_it: Always va prima del verbo; look after resta unito.

cards.ex: We got on the bus at the station.
Get off at the next stop.
I'll pick you up at eight.
Dad dropped me off at school.
